text.8:12: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I am with you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger.
text.13:5: And if thou wonderest, then wondrous is their saying: When we are dust, are we then forsooth (to be raised) in a new creation? Such are they who disbelieve in their Lord; such have carcans on their necks; such are rightful owners of the Fire, they will abide therein.
text.17:13: And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.
text.17:29: And let not thy hand be chained to thy neck nor open it with a complete opening, lest thou sit down rebuked, denuded.
text.26:4: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
text.34:33: Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?
text.36:8: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
text.38:33: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
